text:
[LSER.17.7] Type applicability and time-model applicability
are orthogonal axes. A `min` aggregation requires a numeric
type (per [LSER.17.2]) **and** a time model that admits exact
min / max (`all_time`, `sliding`, `sample` — `tumbling` has no exact
backing, § [LSER.18]). Both axes must be satisfied. The compiler reports
the first failing axis.
